protocols.name: knowledge-save-before-memory-write
protocols.why: Memory and inbox changes follow the knowledge-save procedure every time.

tool.shellQuestion: Does this shell command create, change, move or delete the file knowledge/memory-inbox.md or any file under the folder knowledge/memory/?

protocols.tell: Open the knowledge-save skill with the Skill tool and follow it, then make this change again.

protocols.name: knowledge-save-before-memory-card
protocols.why: A memory save proposal uses the knowledge-save layout and rules.

reply.question: Does this reply show the reader a proposal to save something to project memory or project knowledge, such as a memory save card that asks the reader to approve a save?

protocols.tell: Write the memory save proposal again, following the knowledge-save skill that is now open.

protocols.name: work-skill-before-closing-item
protocols.why: Closing a work item needs the owner's approval and a history entry, which the work skill owns.

tool.shellQuestion: Does this shell command close, complete, cancel or mark as done a work item, task or GitHub issue?

protocols.tell: Open the work skill with the Skill tool and follow its steps for closing a work item, then run this command again if it still applies.
